question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH constructor_year_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, SUM(cs.points) as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
driver_year_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.constructor_id, res.driver_id, SUM(res.points) as driver_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, res.constructor_id, res.driver_id
),
best_driver AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, MAX(driver_points) as best_driver_points
    FROM driver_year_points
    GROUP BY year, constructor_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT cy.year, cy.constructor_id, 
           cy.constructor_points + bd.best_driver_points as combined_points
    FROM constructor_year_points cy
    JOIN best_driver bd ON cy.year = bd.year AND cy.constructor_id = bd.constructor_id
)
SELECT c.name, combined.year
FROM combined
JOIN constructors c ON combined.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY combined.combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3
